en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a grand historic building with a large arched windowed façade and two symmetrical towers. The front of the building is covered with climbing plants and surrounded by a formal garden. In the foreground there is a circular fountain pool with a water jet, pathways, flowerbeds, and benches. The caption at the bottom left reads "Leipzig. Palmengarten".
